description: Sea of Secrets — Cybersecurity Capture The Flag (CTF) HackitUp presents Sea of Secrets , an exciting cybersecurity Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed for cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and aspiring ethical hackers. Get ready to dive into a series of challenging cybersecurity problems, test your technical skills, and uncover the secrets hidden across different security domains. Event Date 31st October 2026 Event Format Individual participation Participants will compete independently; team participation is not allowed Open to cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and professionals Participants from different colleges, universities, and specializations can participate What to Expect Participants will encounter challenges across multiple areas of cybersecurity, including: Web Security Cryptography Digital Forensics OSINT Reverse Engineering Steganography Miscellaneous Security Challenges And Many More.... Why Participate? Test your practical cybersecurity skills Solve real-world inspired security challenges Compete with cybersecurity enthusiasts from across the community Showcase your problem-solving and technical abilities Win exciting prizes, goodies, and recognition Rules Participation is strictly individual-based . Sharing flags, solutions, or answers with other participants is strictly prohibited. Participants must not attempt to disrupt the CTF infrastructure or other participants' access. Any form of cheating or exploitation of the competition infrastructure may result in disqualification. Participants are expected to follow ethical hacking practices throughout the competition. Further rules and challenge-specific guidelines will be communicated before the event. Dive Into the Challenge Think you have what it takes to uncover the Sea of Secrets ?

raw.details:
Sea of Secrets — Cybersecurity Capture The Flag (CTF)

  • HackitUp presents Sea of Secrets, an exciting cybersecurity Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed for cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and aspiring ethical hackers.
  • Get ready to dive into a series of challenging cybersecurity problems, test your technical skills, and uncover the secrets hidden across different security domains.

Event Date

  • 31st October 2026

Event Format

  • Individual participation
  • Participants will compete independently; team participation is not allowed
  • Open to cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and professionals
  • Participants from different colleges, universities, and specializations can participate

What to Expect

Participants will encounter challenges across multiple areas of cybersecurity, including:

  • Web Security
  • Cryptography
  • Digital Forensics
  • OSINT
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Steganography
  • Miscellaneous Security Challenges
  • And Many More....

Why Participate?

  • Test your practical cybersecurity skills
  • Solve real-world inspired security challenges
  • Compete with cybersecurity enthusiasts from across the community
  • Showcase your problem-solving and technical abilities
  • Win exciting prizes, goodies, and recognition

Rules

  • Participation is strictly individual-based.
  • Sharing flags, solutions, or answers with other participants is strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must not attempt to disrupt the CTF infrastructure or other participants' access.
  • Any form of cheating or exploitation of the competition infrastructure may result in disqualification.
  • Participants are expected to follow ethical hacking practices throughout the competition.
  • Further rules and challenge-specific guidelines will be communicated before the event.

Dive Into the Challenge

Think you have what it takes to uncover the Sea of Secrets?
